title: Divergence: doc-drift.py tracebacks with exit 1 on a TOML-valid but wrong-shaped route table (REQ-9 demands exit 3)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at tooling/tests/test_doc_drift_critic.py::test_c2_wrong_shape_route_table_is_exit_3_not_traceback demonstrates divergence (DOC_DRIFT_DIVERGENCE=1). route = 5 or route = ["a"] parses as TOML, then load_doc_files raises TypeError/AttributeError -> unhandled traceback, Python exit 1 — REQ-9's DRIFT-FOUND class, so a broken route table is misreported as a drift finding, and the 'never a traceback' contract (REQ-9/AC-5 discipline, restated in the gate's own docstring) is broken. Expected: exit 3, no Traceback. Toolchain site: def load_doc_files in tooling/doc-drift.py (shape of data['route'] never validated).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Plan (R-FIX, single file tooling/doc-drift.py):

Root cause: load_doc_files iterates 'for route in data.get(route, [])' with no shape validation. When spec-routes.toml parses as valid TOML but route is non-list (route = 5 -> int) or a list of non-tables (route = [a] -> str entries), the loop / .get() calls raise an unhandled TypeError -> Python exits 1 with a traceback. Authority REQ-9: a malformed enumeration source is an ENVIRONMENT failure (exit 3, INCONCLUSIVE), never a drift finding (exit 1), never a traceback / fail-open.

Fix: after tomllib.load succeeds, validate the loaded shape inside load_doc_files: data.get(route) must be a list (else EnvironmentError3 naming the defect); each entry must be a dict/TOML table (else EnvironmentError3); each entrys design and crate_pattern must be a non-empty str (else EnvironmentError3). Any violation raises EnvironmentError3 with a loud message naming the defect, which main() catches -> exit 3. Composes with the #259 zero-routes guard already present. Convention: doc-drift.py deliberately does NOT mirror spec-discipline.pys fail-open return {route:[]}; a CI tripwire that fails open is a silent pass (R-HONEST-3), so malformed input is INCONCLUSIVE here.

Also: ungate test_c2 (remove @unittest.skipUnless) so it is permanent regression coverage.

Gauntlet: python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v (12 run, 0 skipped, all pass); python3 tooling/doc-drift.py live (exit 1, 48 MISSING-PIN + 1 DRIFT); git diff -- scripts/audit.sh empty.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
FIXED in 73776c32c37b047974debc0f842325bf2192e831 (single file tooling/doc-drift.py; +27 LOC fix, plus test ungate).

Root cause: load_doc_files ran 'for route in data.get(route, [])' with no shape validation. A TOML-valid wrong-shaped table made it iterate a non-list (route = 5 -> TypeError) or call .get() on a non-dict entry (route = [a] -> AttributeError) -> unhandled traceback, exit 1 (REQ-9 DRIFT class). Authority .design/tooling/doc-drift-tripwire.md REQ-9: a malformed enumeration source is INCONCLUSIVE (exit 3, spec-routes.toml unreadable), never a drift finding, never a traceback, never fail-open (R-HONEST-3).

Fix: in load_doc_files, after tomllib.load, validate shape before the loop and raise EnvironmentError3 (caught by main -> exit 3) naming the defect: route must be a list; each entry a [[route]] table; each design/crate_pattern, if present, a string. Composes with the #259 zero-routes guard. doc-drift.py does NOT adopt spec-discipline.pys fail-open return {route:[]} (that gate is fail-open by design; a tripwire that fails open is a silent pass).

before: for route in data.get(route, []):  # TypeError on route = 5
after:  routes = data.get(route, []); isinstance(list)/isinstance(dict)/isinstance(str) guards -> EnvironmentError3

Probe (both wrong shapes now exit 3, loud, no traceback):
  route = 5      -> 'route table tooling/spec-routes.toml is wrong-shaped: route must be a list of [[route]] tables, got int' EXIT=3
  route = [a]  -> '... route entry #0 must be a [[route]] table, got str' EXIT=3

Ungated test_c2_wrong_shape_route_table_is_exit_3_not_traceback (removed DOC_DRIFT_DIVERGENCE skip) -> permanent regression coverage.

Gauntlet (integer counts):
  python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v : 12 run, 0 skipped, OK (all pass)
  python3 tooling/doc-drift.py (live tree) : exit 1, 48 MISSING-PIN + 1 DRIFT
  git diff -- scripts/audit.sh : empty (AC-7 byte-identical)

No new pub API (R-DEFER-1 n/a). Hand back to acto-critic for re-audit.
